turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping timing is a little different with us because you choose the timeframe instead of us assigning a fixed “standard” window.

Here’s how it works:

In the United States
At checkout, you’ll see a delivery calendar and can pick an estimated arrival date that works for you.
The dates shown already factor in: time for us to prepare your plants + normal carrier transit time to your address.
We use standard ground shipping; we do not offer expedited or same-day shipping.
All dates are estimates, since things like weather and carrier delays can affect transit.
In Canada (where eligible)
At checkout, you choose a ship week instead of a specific day.
Your order is prepared and shipped during that week, then typically moves to FedEx 2‑day delivery once it reaches the border.
Delivery timing is still estimated, not guaranteed.
Planning around planting time
You can schedule delivery up to about 8 months in advance.
It is best to pick a timeframe that lines up with safe planting in your area (after your last spring frost, or at least 6 weeks before your first fall frost).

If you tell me what you’re ordering (roses, perennials, or bulbs) and your state or province, I can help you think through the best delivery window for your climate.

What's your return and refund policy?

Hi, here’s the quick overview of our return and refund policy:

• Live plants We do not accept returns on live plants.

Roses are covered by a one-year guarantee.
Perennials are covered by a 90-day guarantee.
Bulbs, tubers, roots, seeds, and corms are covered by a failure-to-bloom guarantee. If a warranty claim is approved, you’ll receive store credit valid for one year.

• Gardening tools and other hard goods Unused items in new condition may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Customers are responsible for return shipping costs.

• Garden Markers, tags, and stakes These are custom engraved items, so they are non-returnable.

• Fertilizers, soil amendments, beneficial insects, and plant treatments These items are final sale and are not covered by warranty.

For the full details, you can review our guarantee page here: Our Guarantee

If you want, I can also help with the policy for a specific item type.

Before closing the program, we emailed instructions so members could convert any qualifying unused points into gift cards that never expire, and we supported that conversion through December 31, 2023. As of that date, the program is fully closed and we are no longer able to access or convert points.

We’re still finding ways to reward frequent shoppers through promotional and VIP discounts. If you’d like to hear about those, you can sign up for our email newsletter by scrolling to the bottom of any page on our site and entering your email address.
